## What Serenity Spa offers

- Swimming pool
- Fitness center
- Finnish sauna
- Steam sauna
- Jacuzzi
- Signature massages
- Body treatments, peels and wraps
- Spa packages for men, women and couples
- Wellness memberships

## Key prices

- Day pass weekdays: 600,000 UZS
- Day pass weekends: 700,000 UZS
- Balinese massage 60 minutes: 1,000,000 UZS
- Balinese massage 90 minutes: 1,300,000 UZS
- Lymphatic drainage detox massage 90 minutes: 1,350,000 UZS
- Back, neck and shoulder massage 30 minutes: 800,000 UZS
- Body wraps 60 minutes: 850,000 UZS
- Couples spa package 4 hours: 5,000,000 UZS
- Memberships: 12 visits from 4,500,000 UZS; monthly and annual formats available

## Booking

Guests can book through the website form or by phone. Online form requests are confirmed by an administrator before the visit.
